name: Motorcycle
description: Any motor vehicle with a saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels, including motor scooters. Mississippi has no moped category, so an electric two-wheeler over the e-bike limits is a motorcycle at any power. Defined by Mississippi Code §63-3-103(c), which excludes electric bicycles.
restrictions: A saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground; electric bicycles are excluded
No lower or upper limit on motor power or speed
Includes motor scooters, step-through two-wheelers with a wheel 10 inches or larger; the definition caps only an internal-combustion scooter's power, at 2.7 brake horsepower and 50 cc
Riders need a driver's license with a motorcycle endorsement, from age 16; a motorcycle learner's permit is available at 15
Every rider must wear a helmet meeting AAMVA criteria
Registered with a license tag, and the owner must show liability insurance to get one
